places.name: Cihangir
tips: Most of the places in this guide are in Cihangir or the wider Beyoğlu area.
places.what_it_is: Leafy, cafe-heavy residential quarter; base for most places in this guide.
places.background: Hillside residential quarter of Beyoğlu between Taksim/Sıraselviler and the Bosphorus shore at Fındıklı. Known for a bohemian, artsy reputation, cafés and street cats; Cihangir Mosque sits at its lower end.

photos.credit: Photo: Grzegorz Jereczek from Gdańsk, Poland · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Doğacıyız Gourmet
places.pp: ₺725 (set breakfast) plus drinks; à la carte menemen ₺220–300
tips: Eastern cuisine, more touristy.
places.what_it_is: Hatay-flavoured breakfast spread in Cihangir, different from the usual Turkish kahvaltı and more geared to visitors.
places.background: Antakya (Hatay)-style breakfast house in Cihangir, running for about 14 years by its own account. It is known for the serpme Antakya breakfast (biberli ekmek, tuzlu yoğurt, zahter, muhammara, sürk), muhlama and Hatay-style gözleme. Yemek.com says produce comes from their own land and is sold by the jar.
places.address: Kılıçali Paşa, Akarsu Yokuşu Sk. No:41A, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Ağa Bilardo Cafe (the menemen billiard hall)
places.warning: Identified as the only billiard hall found in Cihangir; no review mentions its menemen yet. Confirm it's the right one.
tips: The best menemen, in a weird place: a billiard hall in Cihangir.
Perfect for two: share a menemen with cheese and a gözleme with cheese, with tea.
places.what_it_is: Old-school Cihangir billiard hall/kahvehane doing cheap tea, tost and (per Andrés) a great menemen.
places.background: Neighbourhood billiard hall and café in Cihangir where locals play billiards, okey and tavla. Reviewers praise the tost (with pickles on the side) and always-fresh tea, and one mekan.com reviewer calls it 'perhaps the only billiard hall you can come to with family'.
places.address: Firuzağa, Taktaki Yokuşu No:2/A (off Sıraselviler Cd.), Cihangir, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Van Kahvaltı Evi
tips: Favourite #2. Simple, less sophisticated, but everything you get is delicious.
places.what_it_is: Hugely popular Van-style breakfast spread. Expect a line on weekends; weekdays are calmer.
places.background: Cihangir institution serving Van-style (eastern Anatolian) breakfast: murtuğa, kavut, otlu peynir, çemen, pişi, gözleme and fresh pomegranate juice. It is famous for its weekend queue. Time Out notes a sister branch in Nişantaşı (Valikonağı Cad., Sezai Selek Sk. 19).
places.address: Kılıçali Paşa / Firuzağa, Defterdar Yokuşu No:52/A, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Kahve 6
tips: Favourite #1. Gourmet, curated ingredients, back garden.
Try the İzmir breakfast, the goat cheese omelette and the lor peynirli gözleme.
places.what_it_is: Cosy Cihangir breakfast café with a green back garden, Andrés's #1.
places.background: Long-standing Cihangir neighbourhood café (already reviewed by Time Out in 2011) with a back garden with a pool, open for breakfast and home cooking. Yemek.com (2024) highlights the 'Dolu Dolu' breakfast, the İzmir breakfast (sahanda Bergama tulum, Tire karadut, lor), the aubergine börek, the lor gözleme and the house granola.
places.address: Kılıçali Paşa Mah., Akarsu Cad., Anahtar Sk. No:13/A, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Halil Usta Kebap & Lahmacun
tips: Get the Adana kebab dürüm, the lahmacun and the lentil soup.
places.what_it_is: Cheap, quick Adana dürüm / lahmacun / lentil soup stop near Taksim.
places.background: Small kebab and lahmacun shop on Hocazade Sokak just off Sıraselviler Caddesi, between Taksim and Cihangir.
places.address: Katip Mustafa Çelebi Mah., Hocazade Sk. No:7/A (off Sıraselviler Cd.), 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Baran Lahmacun
tips: For Adana kebab, lahmacun, lentil soup and the tavuk (chicken) wrap.
places.what_it_is: Sit-down lahmacun-and-kebab place: lahmacun, Adana, lentil soup and chicken şiş dürüm are all on the menu.
places.background: Diyarbakır-style stone-oven lahmacun and kebab restaurant on Turnacıbaşı Caddesi, between Galatasaray and Cihangir. Menu covers Diyarbakır and Antep lahmacun, pide, Adana/Urfa kebab, sac tava, dürüms and künefe, plus breakfast.
places.address: Kuloğlu Mah., Turnacıbaşı Cd. No:39/A, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Mayko Lokanta
places.what_it_is: Tiny, cosy meze-and-home-cooking spot; good for mixed vegan/meat groups; book ahead.
places.background: Small family-and-friends-run restaurant in Cihangir with a short menu of modern home-style Turkish dishes and meze, including dolma, eggplant balls, fava and many vegan options. Reviewers call it cosy and shabby-chic, with only a few tables.
places.address: Kuloğlu Mah., Hacıoğlu Sk. No:1A, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Tomtom Kebap
places.what_it_is: Tiny, very popular with tourists. Kebab and wraps, often a queue.
places.background: Small kebab and dürüm shop on Yeni Çarşı Caddesi, said to have been founded in 2018 (Mapstr, unverified). Known for Adana and Urfa kebab, lamb dürüm, hummus and lentil soup, with a few sidewalk tables.
places.address: Firuzağa, Yeni Çarşı Cd. 39 A, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Limonlu Bahçe
tips: Turkish restaurant with very, very nice vibes in Cihangir, set in a garden that makes you forget the hustle and bustle of the city. My go-to place to bring people while it's still warm enough.
places.what_it_is: Leafy hidden garden for breakfast, a long lunch or evening drinks. More about the setting than the food.
places.background: Opened in June 2001 and billed as Istanbul's first 'chill-out zone'. It is a 350 m² hidden garden of lemon, magnolia, pine and linden trees, with resident tortoises, behind the French Consulate on Yeni Çarşı. It serves breakfast through late drinks with a Turkish–Mediterranean menu, house lemonade and cocktails (official site).
places.address: Tomtom Mh., Yeni Çarşı Cd. No:74, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Journey
tips: Delicious food in a plant-filled space. Lots of freelancers work from here, especially on weekdays.
places.what_it_is: Laid-back all-day Cihangir cafe-restaurant with a work-friendly upstairs; good food, a bit pricey.
places.background: Two-storey café-restaurant on Akarsu Caddesi in Cihangir, on Foursquare since 2010 and a neighbourhood staple. Turkish-inspired food with a European twist (e.g. honey-roasted lamb shank), brunch, cocktails, and a mezzanine/upstairs with a communal table popular with laptop workers.
places.address: Kılıçali Paşa Mah., Akarsu Cd. (Akarsu Yokuşu) No:21/A, Cihangir, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Susam Cafe
tips: Great place to work if you want good food too. Has outside and semi-outside tables, a few with plug sockets.
places.what_it_is: Relaxed all-day Cihangir cafe that turns into a bar at night; terrace tables.
places.background: Long-running neighbourhood café-bar on Susam Sokak in Cihangir, reviewed by Time Out back in 2011. Serves breakfast, salads, burgers, wraps, pasta and flatbread pizza, and stays open late as a bar; its signature drink is the 'Egeli Mojito' with black mulberry.
places.address: Kılıçali Paşa Mah., Susam Sk. No:11, Cihangir, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Emily's Garden
tips: A gorgeous garden in the middle of Cihangir. Quite fancy at night, but in the daytime it's quiet and peaceful.
places.what_it_is: Hidden garden bistro: calm daytime work/brunch spot, romantic dinner and drinks at night.
places.background: Garden restaurant on Susam Sokak in Cihangir, on the site formerly occupied by The White Mill (which moved to Akaretler); on Foursquare since 2019. A small café front leads to a bar and long tables and a tree-lit back garden; Mediterranean/Italian-leaning menu with pasta and seafood, plus breakfast and brunch.
places.address: Pürtelaş Hasan Efendi Mah., Susam Sk. No:13, 34427 Cihangir, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Müz Botanik & Kahve
places.what_it_is: Plant-filled neighbourhood café for a coffee break in Çukurcuma.
places.background: Small plant-filled café on Hayriye Caddesi in Çukurcuma. Time Out Istanbul (2016) described it as a place where you sip Petra's coffee while feeling like you're in a tiny forest, and a good stop for reading.
places.address: Firuzağa, Hayriye Cd. 18/A, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Mellow
tips: My go-to place in Cihangir for a drink, and maybe a quick bite, with friends after work.
The Tinkerbell cocktail (passion fruit and kiwi) is delicious.
places.what_it_is: Easy after-work drinks and tapas in Cihangir; upstairs is the nicer floor.
places.background: Two-floor tapas kitchen and bar on Akarsu Yokuşu, Cihangir's main bar street, with Turkish-fusion tapas, mezes, boutique Turkish wines and cocktails; reviewed by Time Out in 2015.
places.address: Kılıçali Paşa Mah., Akarsu Yokuşu No:30/B, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Geyik
places.what_it_is: Tiny, crowded Cihangir cocktail bar; drinks on the pavement with the regulars.
places.background: Small brick-walled third-wave coffee roastery that turns into a busy cocktail bar at night, a Cihangir fixture since at least 2014 (Time Out review, Sept 2014), with crowds spilling onto Akarsu Yokuşu.
places.address: Kılıçali Paşa Mah., Akarsu Yokuşu No:22/A, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Cafe 21 Cihangir
tips: The kitchen is open almost the whole night; it's the only place around like that.
places.what_it_is: Packed neighbourhood bar-restaurant where you can still eat at 2–3 am; hard to get an outside table.
places.background: Long-running Cihangir café-bar-restaurant on Coşkun Sokak off Akarsu Yokuşu, about ten steps from Geyik. Popular with young locals, with veranda tables and a full food menu (mantı mentioned) served into the small hours.
places.address: Akarsu Yokuşu Cd., Coşkun Sk. No:2/1 (some listings: No:21), 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Zeytuna
tips: Alternative bar-restaurant: an expat hub, with blues nights, tango nights and more.
places.what_it_is: Levantine dinner spot with a bar and event nights; very good falafel and many veggie options.
places.background: Restaurant, bar and events space on the first floor of the Cezayir building, mixing Lebanese, Syrian, Palestinian and Turkish cooking (Time Out). It also runs a cultural programme of music nights.
places.address: Firuzağa, Hayriye Cd. No:12 (Cezayir building, 1st floor), 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Kaktüs Cihangir
places.what_it_is: Cihangir institution: breakfast/brunch by day, cocktails and gastropub food at night.
places.background: Cihangir offshoot of the old Kaktüs off İstiklal, opened because many regulars had moved to the neighbourhood; one of Cihangir's most rooted venues, with a winter garden. Café and breakfast spot by day, bar and restaurant by night, with a weekly Wednesday record night.
places.address: Pürtelaş Hasan Efendi, Cihangir Cd. No:16/A, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Tavern
places.warning: Aug 2025 TripAdvisor review reports being charged the higher price for smaller cocktails plus a service fee; check the bill.
places.what_it_is: Small, busy DJ cocktail bar a few doors from Zeytuna; creative drinks, pricier than average.
places.background: Small cocktail bar on Hayriye Caddesi (the Cezayir/Firuzağa strip next to Cihangir), listed on TripAdvisor as 'chic yet rebellious' with signature cocktails and DJ sets.
places.address: Firuzağa, Hayriye Cd. No:16/A, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Solera Winery
tips: A small bar with a huge variety of wines.
places.what_it_is: Cosy, crowded wine cave with a huge Turkish wine choice; food is secondary.
places.background: Long-standing small wine shop and bar off İstiklal, lined floor-to-ceiling with bottles, one of the pioneers of Istanbul's wine-bar scene. Large Turkish and imported list; bottles can be bought to take away at a discount; simple mezes, cheese and pasta.
places.address: Tomtom Mah., Yeni Çarşı Cd. No:44, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Ziba
places.what_it_is: Unpretentious corner pub where the crowd spills into the street; casual drinks.
places.background: Long-standing corner pub just off İstiklal near Galatasaray, a Beyoğlu favourite in Time Out. Its crowd routinely spills onto the street and the summer terrace; draught and bottled beers, signature cocktails, burgers and snacks.
places.address: Tomtom, Akansu Sk. No:10, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: MiniMüzikhol
places.what_it_is: Intimate, sweaty underground house/minimal room; the late-night reference for Cihangir.
places.background: Small (RA capacity 200) unsigned club on the ground floor of a Cihangir apartment block, running since around 2009–2010; bills itself as 'the oldest underground club in Istanbul' and has hosted the likes of Ivan Smagghe, Acid Pauli and DJ Tennis.
places.address: Soğancı Sk. (Cihangir Palas) No:3/1, Cihangir, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

photos.credit: Photo: minimuzikhol.club

places.name: Kiki
places.what_it_is: Popular Taksim bar-club: dinner/cocktails early, house and tech-house dancing late, long queues at weekends.
places.background: Opened as a tea shop in Çukurcuma and moved to Sıraselviler in 2008 (RA venue blurb); a restaurant-bar in front with a garden and a back room that becomes a club with house-party-style DJ nights until morning.
places.address: Sıraselviler Cd. No:42, Beyoğlu/İstanbul (opposite the German Hospital)

places.name: Roxy
places.what_it_is: Veteran Taksim club now mostly hosting promoter nights (techno, hardcore, Latin) and concerts.
places.background: Taksim club running since 1994; CNN Türk (23 Oct 2025) reported it opened a new season on 26 Sep 2025, describing it as 30 years at the heart of Istanbul nightlife, with founder Cem Selcen. Its electronic arm operates as RX Istanbul.
places.address: Arslanyatağı Sk., Cihangir, Beyoğlu/İstanbul (corner of Sıraselviler Cd.; RA: No:5, Time Out: No:1/3)

places.name: Let's Relax Cihangir
tips: 45-minute massage: Thai, Thai with oil ('Thai for beginners') or a standard Swedish.
places.what_it_is: Clean, professional Thai-style massage studio; Fresha rating 5.0 from 112 reviews.
places.background: Cihangir branch of a small Istanbul massage chain (Taksim İstiklal, Cihangir, Beşiktaş, Nişantaşı) offering Thai, Thai-with-oil, Swedish, aromatherapy and deep-tissue massages plus nails/waxing; Thai therapists. Apparently unrelated to the Thai 'Let's Relax Spa' chain.
places.address: Kuloğlu Mah., Sıraselviler Cd., Mavi Plaza No:84 Kat:2, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Ağa Hamamı
tips: Around 100 m down the road. Lovely, though a little more touristy. Most hamams are single-sex; Ağa Hamamı is mixed.
places.what_it_is: Traditional package ₺3,600 by card / ₺3,100 cash = entry (₺1,800) + kese scrub (₺900) + foam wash (₺900); with 20-min oil massage ₺5,600 / ₺5,100. Kese, soap, shampoo, peştemal, towel and slippers provided.
places.background: Small historic bath the hamam says Mehmed the Conqueror built in 1454 as a hunting lodge with a bath below, renovated in 1844 under Abdülmecid; it markets itself as Istanbul's oldest Turkish bath.
places.address: Turnacıbaşı Sk., Kuloğlu, Beyoğlu/İstanbul (OSM: No:66; Time Out: No:48)

places.name: Galata
tips: Right next to Cihangir, only 15 min walk away. It has the famous Galata Tower (definitely worth going up for the incredible view), as well as a bunch of tasty restaurants, cafés and vintage shops.
places.what_it_is: Touristy but atmospheric hill around Galata Tower; good for wandering, food and shops.
places.background: Historic Genoese-era quarter on the north side of the Golden Horn, centred on the 14th-century Galata Tower. Steep lanes with restaurants, cafés, music and vintage shops run down from Tünel/İstiklal towards Karaköy.

photos.credit: Photo: Juraj Patekar · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: A.Savin · FAL · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Alexxx Malev · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Lades Menemen
places.what_it_is: No-frills spot off İstiklal for a pan of menemen.
places.background: Small, simple Beyoğlu eatery on Sadri Alışık Sokak (off İstiklal), known for its menemen.
places.address: Katip Mustafa Çelebi Mah., Sadri Alışık Sk. No:11/12, 34435 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Suat Usta Mersin Tantuni
places.what_it_is: Late-night tantuni dürüm counter; the obvious replacement for Emine Ana.
places.background: Long-running Mersin tantuni counter in the back streets off İstiklal near Taksim. Yemek.com and The Guide Istanbul both list it, and yummyistanbul.com describes it as a one-dish shop where crowds from İstiklal and Nevizade end their night. It serves tantuni with Mersin şalgam and pickled peppers.
places.address: Katip Mustafa Çelebi Mah., Büyükparmakkapı Tel Sk. No:1 (Çukurlu Çeşme Sk. corner), 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Anas Chicken
tips: A chain with restaurants mostly in Syria and a few in Turkey; Syrian friends are obsessed with it. Get the fried chicken or a dürüm to go for an easy lunch.
places.what_it_is: Syrian fried chicken and shawarma dürüm, mainly takeaway; the Beyoğlu branch is a short walk from İstiklal.
places.background: Syrian chain (Anas Gıda Grubu) founded in Damascus in 1991, known for broasted fried chicken, chicken shawarma/dürüm and kabsa. In Turkey it lists three active Istanbul branches: Beyoğlu (Taksim), Aksaray and Kayaşehir.
places.address: Kuloğlu Mah., Sadri Alışık Sk. No:8, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Dürümzade
tips: Hole-in-the-wall for Hatay food, spicier than western Turkey's. Famous since Anthony Bourdain gave it his blessing. The best dürüm I've had in Turkey.
places.what_it_is: Hole-in-the-wall charcoal dürüm shop (lamb, Adana, chicken, liver) with a lot of tourist traffic since Bourdain.
places.background: Tiny dürüm shop a few minutes' walk from İstiklal Caddesi. It became famous after Anthony Bourdain ate there on 'No Reservations' (Istanbul episode). He ate a lamb şiş dürüm; the double-lamb 'duble kuzu dürüm' is the signature.
places.address: Hüseyinağa Mah., Kamer Hatun Cd. No:26/A (corner of Topçekenler Sk.), 34435 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Asmalı Mescit Dürümcü
places.what_it_is: Late-night dürüm stop among the Asmalımescit meyhanes.
places.background: Small dürüm and kebab shop on Nergiz Sokak in the Asmalımescit bar district, open late.
places.address: Şahkulu Mah., Nergiz Sk. No:2/A, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Helvetia
places.what_it_is: Cheap, busy point-and-choose home cooking (pazı borani, köfte, dolma, legumes); lunch is the peak.
places.background: A no-frills home-cooking lokanta in a former beerhouse on a side street by Tünel; the old 'Helvetia' name painted on the wall is a remnant of the original building. Food is chosen by pointing at seasonal, mostly vegetarian dishes on the counter by the open kitchen; Time Out once gave it its 'best home-cooked food' award. No alcohol (Time Out).
places.address: Asmalı Mescit, General Yazgan Sk. No:8, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Zübeyir Ocakbaşı
places.what_it_is: Classic, busy ocakbaşı. Sit at the grill counter. Book ahead at weekends.
places.background: Taksim grill house over three floors, opened in 2006 by grill master Zübeyir (Time Out). The official site traces the family's start in the trade to 1986, with brothers Hamit and Zübeyir. Known for Adana kebab, ribs (kaburga), liver, gavurdağı salad and quince dessert.
places.address: Şehit Muhtar Mh., Bekar Sk. No:28, 34435 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Fıccın
tips: Outdoor restaurant just off İstiklal, on a little side street. Delicious Caucasian food with tasty wines.
Must-tries: the shredded Circassian chicken (çerkez tavuğu), the dumplings, and the meze starters, including aubergine in tomato sauce and beetroot with yoghurt.
places.what_it_is: Long-running, good-value Circassian home cooking with outdoor tables on a side street off İstiklal.
places.background: Opened in 1996 by Leyla Kılıç Karakaynak on pedestrian Kallavi Sokak. It has since spread across several shopfronts on the street. Named after its signature Circassian meat pastry, it also serves çerkez tavuğu, Circassian mantı and olive-oil dishes, and unusually for a lokanta it serves alcohol.
places.address: Asmalı Mescit Mh., Kallavi Sk. No:13/1 (off İstiklal Cd.), 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Eleos
tips: A tasty rakı-balık (rakı and fish) on İstiklal. Not the cheapest, but some of the best fish I've ever eaten, and a stunning view onto the Bosphorus.
places.what_it_is: Rakı-balık with a view, upstairs from İstiklal. Pricey for fish, which is charged at the daily market price.
places.background: Greek-leaning fish and meze restaurant on the 2nd floor of the historic Hıdivyal Palas on İstiklal near Tünel, with blue-and-white decor and a terrace view (Lonely Planet). There is a separate older branch in Yeşilköy. It is known for fresh fish, grilled octopus and herb-heavy Turkish and Greek mezes.
places.address: Şahkulu Mh., İstiklal Cd. No:231, Hıdivyal Palas Kat 2, Beyoğlu (Tünel)/İstanbul

places.name: Tavanarası
places.what_it_is: Cosy, cramped attic spot with güveç and meze. You write your order on paper. Popular with locals.
places.background: Attic restaurant on the top (6th) floor of Emre Han off Asmalı Mescit, reached by a rickety lift, with wooden decor and tightly packed tables. Known for güveç (casseroles), meze, mücver and grilled fish, and it serves alcohol (Time Out, Frommer's).
places.address: Asmalı Mescit Cd. No:10 Kat 6 (Emre Han), 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Yeni Lokanta
places.pp: ₺7,800 tasting menu (+₺3,750 for 5-glass wine pairing); set menu ₺6,500
places.what_it_is: Chef-driven modern Turkish: à la carte or tasting menu, bright room off İstiklal, Turkish wines.
places.background: Chef Civan Er's restaurant on Kumbaracı Yokuşu, open since at least 2013 (Delicious Istanbul review, June 2013). Lighter, vegetable-forward modern Turkish cooking with local produce and an all-Turkish wine list; listed in the MICHELIN Guide (selected, 'inspectors' favourite') and on World's 50 Best Discovery.
places.address: Kumbaracı Yokuşu No:66/B, Şahkulu, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Aheste
tips: Slightly more upmarket: a delicious modern take on traditional Turkish food. You sit in a cosy candlelit alcove in the historic Pera district. Service is top notch and the wine list is fabulous.
My friend James says this is the best restaurant in Istanbul.
places.what_it_is: Intimate candlelit modern-Turkish meze and tasting-menu restaurant in Pera; upmarket but not stuffy.
places.background: Small Pera restaurant listed in the MICHELIN Guide Istanbul (selected, no star) for modern Turkish cooking: a bistro area plus a vaulted, candlelit dining room. Menu mixes traditional dishes (grilled lamb heart, kokoreç, dudi pilavı) with modern mezes and a tasting menu, with good vegetarian options.
places.address: Asmalı Mescit Mah., Meşrutiyet Cad. No:107/F, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Galaktion
tips: Georgian, very traditional. Everything is delicious; the standard order for two is the Georgian salad, beef khinkali, Adjaruli khachapuri and chakhokhbili (tomato chicken stew).
It is *compulsory* to wash it down with a shot of chacha, a very strong Georgian spirit.
places.what_it_is: Homely, generous Georgian kitchen: khinkali, adjaruli khachapuri, chakhokhbili, Georgian wines.
places.background: Georgian restaurant named after poet Galaktion Tabidze, founded by Irakli Kakabadze; it began in a small storefront in Galata, moved near Taksim and is now on Şehbender Sokak in Asmalımescit. Known for khinkali, khachapuri and Georgian stews in a book-filled room.
places.address: Asmalı Mescit Mah., Şehbender Sk., 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Petra Roasting Co. (Şişhane)
places.what_it_is: Petra's coffee-and-bakery café next to Şişhane metro, the closest Petra to Galata, Cihangir and Pera.
places.background: Petra calls this its newest café, focused on coffee and bakery, on the ground floor of the Bilsar building in Şişhane. It is on your left as you exit Şişhane metro.
places.address: Evliya Çelebi, Meşrutiyet Cd. No:90/A, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul (ground floor of the Bilsar building)

places.name: Hazzo Pulo (Passage Hazzopulo)
places.what_it_is: Historic courtyard passage off İstiklal; the wine stop inside it is Hazzo Pulo, a small wine house with food.
places.background: Hazzopulo Pasajı is a 19th-century passage between İstiklal and Meşrutiyet with a courtyard of tea houses and cafés. Its Hazzo Pulo wine house (Meşrutiyet Cd. 31B) is a small restaurant/wine bar with a list of Turkish wines, and gives the passage its name in guidebooks.
places.address: Evliya Çelebi Mah., Meşrutiyet Cd. No:31B (Hazzopulo Pasajı), Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Varuna Gezgin Cafe
places.what_it_is: Multi-floor traveller-themed café-bar with a view terrace; breakfast by day, cheap-ish drinks by night.
places.background: Istanbul branch of the Varuna Gezgin traveller-themed café chain (founded by a teacher to promote backpacking), on several floors with a terrace ('Teras') overlooking the Bosphorus and a 'Bahçe' branch at No:77.
places.address: Şahkulu, Kumbaracı Ykş. No:79/D (İstiklal Cd. entrance, Tünel), 34421 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

photos.credit: Photo: varunagezgin.com

places.name: Sensus Wine Boutique
places.what_it_is: Cellar wine bar/shop for tasting Turkish wines with a cheese plate next to Galata Tower.
places.background: Underground wine shop and tasting bar at the foot of Galata Tower focused on Turkish wines (sources cite 350–400+ labels), served with cheese and charcuterie platters. Seating is limited.
places.address: Kuledibi, Bereketzade, Büyük Hendek Cd. No:5, 34420 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Okra İstanbul
places.what_it_is: Upscale skyline restaurant with a bar; go for a sunset cocktail at the bar or a full dinner.
places.background: Restaurant on the 20th floor of The Marmara Taksim with floor-to-ceiling views from the Bosphorus to the historic peninsula. Opened around 2023 (Time Out, Sep 2023) with a seasonal, open-fire Mediterranean/Turkish menu, a cocktail list and Turkish wines; a bar section was added later. Listed in the Michelin Guide (₺₺₺).
places.address: Gümüşsuyu, Osmanlı Sk. No:1/B, 34437 Beyoğlu/İstanbul (The Marmara Taksim, 20th floor)

places.name: Büyük Londra Hotel terrace bar
places.warning: The terrace bar is reported to open in the warm season only; it may be closed from late October. Check before going.
tips: Chill and not so expensive. Go at sunset, in time for the call to prayer echoing over the mosque-filled skyline.
places.what_it_is: Low-key, not-too-expensive hotel rooftop for a sunset drink over the Golden Horn; seasonal.
places.background: Rooftop bar of the Büyük Londra, an 1892 hotel built for Orient Express passengers and known for its eccentric antique lobby. The terrace looks over the Golden Horn and the old city; guides describe it as unpretentious, with a simple menu and moderate prices.
places.address: Asmalı Mescit Mh, Meşrutiyet Cd. No:53, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Mikla bar
tips: The bar of this exclusive restaurant is open to everyone without a reservation. Probably the best view of Istanbul.
A small terrace in winter, still really worth it; in summer the top floor becomes a whole bar. A bit fancier than the others.
places.what_it_is: Fancy rooftop bar of a top restaurant: panoramic views and cocktails, priced accordingly.
places.background: Mikla is chef Mehmet Gürs's New Anatolian restaurant on top of The Marmara Pera, listed among the World's 50 Best Restaurants (2022 badge on its site). Its roof-terrace bar is open until 02:00 and has one of the widest views over the Golden Horn, old city and Bosphorus.
places.address: Asmalı Mescit, The Marmara Pera, Meşrutiyet Cd. No:15, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Balkon
places.warning: Check the bill: a July 2026 Yandex review says staff once tried to add a ₺300 service charge and removed it only after the guest objected.
places.what_it_is: Casual, mid-priced rooftop with a big view; easier on the wallet than the hotel rooftops nearby.
places.background: Rooftop restaurant-bar on the 6th floor of a building on Şehbender Sokak, running since 2004 (venue site), with a terrace looking over Tünel, the Golden Horn and the historic peninsula. Pub-style food (burgers, pizza, salads) and a long cocktail and wine list; the evening programme moves to dance music.
places.address: Asmalı Mescit, Şehbender Sk. No:5 D:M (6th floor), 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Monkey Istanbul
tips: More electronic music, leaning towards techno.
places.what_it_is: Sunset cocktail rooftop with DJs spinning house and disco; not a techno club.
places.background: Rooftop bar on the 7th floor of the İKSV (Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts) building in Şişhane, with a wooden terrace over the Golden Horn and the historic peninsula. It is a sunset-to-late cocktail bar with signature cocktails, snacks and resident or guest DJs. Time Out describes 'laid-back disco and house'.
places.address: Nejat Eczacıbaşı Binası (İKSV), Sadi Konuralp Cd. No:5, 7th floor, Şişhane, 34433 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Gizli Bahçe
places.what_it_is: Packed, scruffy Nevizade bar that turns into a dance floor late; alternative/electronic DJs.
places.background: Long-running two-floor bar-club hidden among the meyhanes of Nevizade Sokak, known as an LGBTQ-friendly venue with resident DJs and eclectic, worn-in decor (Time Out Istanbul; RA venue 18448).
places.address: Hüseyinağa Mah., Nevizade Sk. No:15, 34435 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Şahika
places.what_it_is: Busy Nevizade landmark: drinks on the lower floors, techno / bass / D&B parties up top late in the week.
places.background: Multi-storey Nevizade building with a pub at street level, lounge floors and a rooftop bar/club with Golden Horn views (Fodor's). RA venue 193037 describes it as a roof bar/club hosting parties, concerts, exhibitions and panels; Time Out notes Küçük Meyhane moved into the Şahika building.
places.address: Hüseyinağa Mah., Nevizade Sk. No:5, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Tarlabaşı Pazarı
places.what_it_is: Sprawling Sunday street market down Tarlabaşı backstreets: produce, dairy, fish, kitchenware, clothes and baked goods.
places.address: Karpuz Sk. area, Bülbül Mah., Tarlabaşı, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Galata Tower
tips: Definitely worth going up for the incredible view.
places.what_it_is: Iconic tower with a 360° panoramic balcony; expect queues.
places.background: Medieval stone tower built by the Genoese in the 14th century as part of the Galata walls. Run as a museum by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism since its 2020 restoration; the viewing balcony gives a 360° panorama over the Golden Horn and Bosphorus.
places.address: Bereketzade Mah., Galata Kulesi, Beyoğlu, İstanbul

photos.credit: Photo: Juraj Patekar · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: BWV784 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Karaköy
tips: 10 min walk from Cihangir, down the hill by the water. A few ivy-filled gorgeous streets to wander around. Grab a drink at any bar that catches your eye.
places.what_it_is: Waterfront district of cafes and bars in restored warehouses and ivy-covered lanes.
places.background: Old port and banking district at the Beyoğlu end of the Galata Bridge, on the waterfront. Since the 2010s its backstreets have filled with cafés, bars and galleries; ferries leave from Karaköy pier.

photos.credit: Photo: Metuboy · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Arild Vågen · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Dosseman · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: A.Savin · FAL · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Karaköy Çorba Evi
tips: Soups. You can ask for a ½ portion as a first course, then go on to the fish restaurant.
places.what_it_is: Cheap soup counter; order a half portion as a starter before a fish dinner.
places.background: Soup house on Mumhane Caddesi with about 20 soups, from mercimek and ezogelin to işkembe and kelle paça. It started in 2011 as a soup-and-stew place and has traded as Karaköy Çorba Evi since 2014. Its website also mentions a Kadıköy location.
places.address: Kemankeş Karamustafa Paşa Mah., Mumhane Cd. No:35/A, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Can Balık (fish wrap, Karaköy)
tips: Balık dürüm: fish wrap.
places.what_it_is: Quick grilled-fish wrap at the Karaköy fish-market stalls.
places.background: One of the small balık-dürüm (grilled fish wrap) stalls on Fermeneciler Caddesi by the Karaköy fish market, near the Galata Bridge.
places.address: Arap Cami Mah., Fermeneciler Cd. No:30/A, 34010 Beyoğlu/İstanbul (Azapkapı)

places.name: Karaköy Lokantası
places.what_it_is: Smart, good-value lokanta/meyhane with tiled interior; taramasalata and beef börek are highlights (Michelin).
places.background: Harbourside Karaköy restaurant listed in the Michelin Guide (₺₺). It serves Turkish and Mediterranean meze, shared plates and traditional dishes with subtle Greek influences. It works as a lokanta at lunch and a meze-and-rakı spot in the evening.
places.address: Kemankeş Mh., Kemankeş Cd. No:57, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Mahkeme Lokantası
places.what_it_is: Tradesmen's lunch lokanta by day, lively street-spilling meyhane by night.
places.background: Housed in the historic Yoğurtçu Han, named after the old Genoese courthouse across the street, with a well-kept brick interior. At lunch it feeds local tradesmen. In the evening it becomes a classic meyhane with crowds spilling onto the street (Time Out 2018). Known for Girit ezme, pastırmalı humus, paçanga böreği and grilled octopus.
places.address: Azapkapı, Perşembe Pazarı Cd. No:14 (Yoğurtçu Han), 34421 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Arada Café
tips: Gorgeous Syrian/Lebanese restaurant in Tophane. Go for the huge Syrian breakfast: similar to the Turkish style, with more delicious dips.
places.what_it_is: Very popular all-day Lebanese/Syrian spot; go for the big Middle-Eastern breakfast.
places.background: Lebanese-Syrian café-restaurant between Galata and Tophane, famous for a huge breakfast spread that adds hummus, fatteh, labneh with za'atar and falafel to the Turkish kahvaltı; also serves mezes and grills all day. A sister venue, Arada Endülüs (Kemeraltı Cd. 31, ~60 m away, same phone), is a pricier version.
places.address: Hacımimi Mah., Lüleci Hendek Cd. No:23A, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Karaköy Gümrük
places.what_it_is: All-day restaurant in an old customs house that turns into a cosy bar in the evening; reviewers like the interior, dumplings and cocktails.
places.background: Restaurant and bar in Karaköy's former customs-directorate building, restored and opened as Karaköy Gümrük in 2014 (per a blog cited in search). Modern-Turkish/Mediterranean kitchen with raki, Turkish wine and cocktails; the bar is on the upper floor, with dark tones and black-and-white photos giving it a vintage feel.
places.address: Kemankeş Karamustafa Paşa, Gümrük Sk. No:4, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Nacht İstanbul
places.warning: Only one Resident Advisor night so far in 2026 and the website says 'coming soon'. Check RA before going.
places.what_it_is: Small house/minimal club in a Karaköy street; programming looks sporadic since mid-2025.
places.background: Karaköy club listed on Resident Advisor (venue 213521, capacity 350) with a red, baroque-meets-modern interior; RA blurb says it specialises in house, minimal house and groovy beats and books DJs including Kater Blau (Berlin) regulars.
places.address: Kemankeş Mah., Mumhane Cd. No:52, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul (Karaköy)

places.name: Kılıç Ali Paşa Hamamı
tips: The more expensive but stunning option, in Karaköy.
places.what_it_is: Traditional Hamam Ritual ₺4,700: rest on the heated marble platform, kese scrub by an attendant, foam wash at the basins. Massages extra (50-min full body ₺5,000; 25-min partial ₺3,800). Strictly single-sex: women 08:00–16:00, men in the evening.
places.background: Built by Mimar Sinan in 1578–1583 for admiral Kılıç Ali Pasha to serve the Tophane mariners; its 14 m dome is the second largest of any Istanbul hamam. Reopened after a long restoration and now a high-end, single-sex bath.
places.address: Kemankeş Mah., Hamam Sk. No:1, 34425 Tophane, Karaköy, Beyoğlu/İstanbul

photos.credit: Photo: Metuboy · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Metuboy · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Takeaway · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: R Prazeres · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Beşiktaş
tips: For football and pub vibes.
places.what_it_is: Lively, local, football-mad centre with lots of pubs; busy on match days.
places.background: European-side district on the Bosphorus, home of Beşiktaş JK and its Tüpraş Stadium. The çarşı (market area) behind the ferry pier is packed with cheap pubs, meyhanes and student bars.

photos.credit: Photo: Chapultepec · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Istanbulensis · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: No machine-readable author provided. Bertilvidet~commonswiki · CC BY 2.5 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Ali Ocakbaşı Gümüşsuyu
tips: Kebab and Turkish food, with a Bosphorus view.
places.what_it_is: Upscale ocakbaşı on İnönü Cd. with a Bosphorus view (per Andrés), polished take on kebab and meze.
places.background: Gümüşsuyu branch of Ali Ocakbaşı, a grill house group with branches in Karaköy, Gümüşsuyu, Suadiye, Amsterdam and Barcelona (official site). It is known for charcoal kebabs, lahmacun and mezes such as muhammara and Girit ezme, and promotes zero-waste, sustainable sourcing.
places.address: Gümüşsuyu, İnönü Cd. No:22, 34870 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Petra Roasting Co. (Gayrettepe)
places.what_it_is: Petra's flagship roastery café in a business district. Go if you're nearby, not worth a detour for visitors.
places.background: Petra's headquarters café and roastery in Gayrettepe, the original Petra.
places.address: Gayrettepe, Hoşsohbet Sk. (Selenium residence), Beşiktaş/İstanbul

places.name: Setup
tips: My favourite bar in the area. Bosphorus view and good food. You might need a reservation at the weekend.
places.what_it_is: Neighbourhood café-bar with a Bosphorus view; cocktails and food, quiet jazz.
places.background: Café-bar on the Kabataş Setüstü strip above the ferry pier, with a Bosphorus view; serves breakfast through dinner and cocktails, and was renovated (Time Out). Sister venues Setup Burger and Deli Meyhane are a few doors down İnebolu Sk.
places.address: Ömer Avni Mah., İnebolu Sk. No:9/15, Setüstü Kabataş, 34427 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Kaiser Kabataş
places.what_it_is: Friendly small gastropub on the Setüstü strip: burgers, bowls, breakfast and cocktails with a water view.
places.background: Small bar and gastropub on İnebolu Sokak near the Kabataş ferry stop, with outdoor seating facing the Bosphorus. TripAdvisor 4.9 (201 reviews), 2026 Travellers' Choice.
places.address: Ömer Avni, İnebolu Sk. No:31/A, Kabataş Setüstü, 34427 Beyoğlu/İstanbul

places.name: Beşiktaş Pazarı
places.what_it_is: Big weekly neighbourhood produce and household market.
places.address: Nüzhetiye Cd., Muradiye/Teşvikiye side, Beşiktaş/İstanbul

places.name: Avokado Bar
tips: Healthy food: vegan, vegetarian and more.
places.what_it_is: Healthy brunch/lunch café in Nişantaşı: avocado toasts, bowls and smoothies. No alcohol on the menu despite the 'bar' name.
places.background: Healthy all-day café and specialty-coffee bar in Teşvikiye. It serves avocado tartines on sourdough, grain bowls (quinoa patties, salmon), smoothie bowls and refined-sugar-free desserts, with many vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options.
places.address: Teşvikiye, Ahmet Fetgari Sk. No:29/B, 34365 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: TURK Fatih Tutak
places.what_it_is: Istanbul's top-tier tasting-menu experience; book weeks ahead, about three hours.
places.background: Chef Fatih Tutak's tasting-menu restaurant in Bomonti, awarded two MICHELIN stars in the first Istanbul guide (October 2022) and still listed with two stars. A single ~12–14-course menu built on Turkish regional produce, served across a city-view lounge, a dining room facing the kitchen, and dessert in the open kitchen; strong Turkish wine list.
places.address: Cumhuriyet Mah., Hacıahmet Silahşör Cad., Yeniyol Sk. No:2, 34440 Şişli/İstanbul (Bomonti)

places.name: Spada Coffee (Nişantaşı)
places.what_it_is: Small self-service specialty coffee bar on a quiet Nişantaşı side street.
places.background: Specialty coffee bar of Spada Roastery, in Teşvikiye since 2016. It is self-service with about 10 tables indoors and out, and serves espresso drinks, pour-overs of its own beans, Japanese matcha, house-made cold teas and refined-sugar-free bakes. Spada also has branches in Fişekhane and a roastery in Bakırköy.
places.address: Teşvikiye, Av. Süreyya Ağaoğlu Sk. No:8/E, 34365 Şişli/İstanbul

photos.credit: Photo: spadacoffee.com

places.name: Petra Roasting Co. (Topağacı)
places.warning: OpenStreetMap labels this address 'Kronotrop Topağacı', while Petra's 2026 site still lists the café. Check before going.
places.what_it_is: Petra's sit-down neighbourhood café in Nişantaşı, with food as well as coffee.
places.background: Neighbourhood branch of Petra Roasting Co., one of Istanbul's early specialty roasters (HQ and roastery in Gayrettepe). Petra describes the Topağacı café as a real mahalle coffee house in historic Topağacı, with a 1930s-inspired interior, a bar-food menu and table service.
places.address: Teşvikiye, Prof. Dr. Orhan Ersek Sk. 18/7, 34365 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: Dekk
places.warning: Dekk's own site now lists only its Akmerkez location (opened Oct 2025); this Maçka terrace may have closed. Check before going.
places.what_it_is: Open-air food court and cocktail bar near Maçka Park; best in good weather.
places.background: Open-air 2,500 m² food hall opened in autumn 2021 on the terrace of the Lütfi Kırdar Congress Centre, with street-food stalls, the dekkBar cocktail bar, concerts and workshops. A second, indoor-outdoor dekk opened in Akmerkez on 11 Oct 2025.
places.address: Harbiye, Darülbedai Cd. No:4 (Lütfi Kırdar Congress Centre terrace), 34367 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: Joker No.5
places.what_it_is: Buzzing Nişantaşı cocktail bar-restaurant with street tables.
places.background: Popular Nişantaşı bar-restaurant on Atiye Sokak with indoor and outdoor seating, drawing locals and visitors; known for cocktails (piña colada, daiquiri) and bar food like mini burgers.
places.address: Harbiye, Atiye Sk. No:5, 34367 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: Efendi Topağacı
places.what_it_is: Hole-in-the-wall local cocktail bar that spills onto the street; crowded on weekends.
places.background: Small street-side cocktail bar in Topağacı run by a mixologist known as 'Dede' (Time Out), with signature cocktails and a mostly local crowd; funk and soul music, packed on weekends.
places.address: Teşvikiye, Hacı Emin Efendi Sk. No:28(/A), 34365 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: Karloff
places.what_it_is: Moody little cocktail bar with a pool table on Nişantaşı's Topağacı bar street.
places.background: Dim, speakeasy-style cocktail bar in Topağacı (Nişantaşı) on the same street as Efendi; cocktails, whisky and a few beers, groovy music and a pool table.
places.address: Teşvikiye, Hacı Emin Efendi Sk. No:41, 34365 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: Blok Cafe Mekan
places.what_it_is: Big multi-space Bomonti bar with live music and a roof area.
places.background: Bomonti venue on Silahşör Caddesi with two bars, a live-music area, exhibition space upstairs and an open roof area at the back; open from midday into the night.
places.address: Cumhuriyet Mah., Silahşör Cd. No:65 (65/B–D), 34380 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: Bosphorus Brewing Company
places.what_it_is: Business-district gastropub with house-brewed craft beer and a terrace; one of the few places in Istanbul pouring its own draught craft.
places.background: English-Turkish brewpub near Gayrettepe metro that brews its own beer on site (Istanbul Pale Ale is the flagship; TableJourney cites 12 house taps). Its website says it has hosted guests for over 14 years; food is British gastropub style (ploughman's, bangers and mash, fish & chips).
places.address: Esentepe, Yıldız Posta Cd. No:1 D:1A, 34394 Şişli/İstanbul

places.name: Feriköy Pazarı
places.what_it_is: Covered market hall in Bomonti that hosts the well-known Feriköy antique/flea market.
places.address: Gökkuşağı Sk. No:6, Cumhuriyet Mah., Şişli/İstanbul (Bomonti/Feriköy)

places.name: Arnavutköy
tips: A beautiful part of Istanbul on the water. Lovely to walk around. Get brunch at A Bit of Eggo, an afternoon beer at Hide Arnavutköy, and vegan food at Gabfoods. You can walk or scooter up along the water to Bebek and beyond, e.g. to Emirgan.
places.what_it_is: Pretty waterside village of wooden houses; good for a stroll along the Bosphorus to Bebek.
places.background: Bosphorus village in Beşiktaş district between Kuruçeşme and Bebek, known for its rows of wooden Ottoman houses and its seafront promenade. A walking/cycling path runs along the water north to Bebek and beyond.

photos.credit: Photo: büys · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Maestroka at English Wikipedia · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Yaguzi · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Ömer Ünlü · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: MSA'nın Restoranı (Sakıp Sabancı Museum)
places.pp: ₺2,500–4,000 for a main + drink (derived from menu)
places.what_it_is: Smart Bosphorus-view terrace restaurant run by culinary-school students; strong food, service can be patchy.
places.background: Training restaurant of Mutfak Sanatları Akademisi (MSA, Istanbul Culinary Arts Academy), opened around 2017 (Foursquare venue created Jul 2017) in the Sakıp Sabancı Museum in the space formerly occupied by Müzedechanga. Students cook and serve under professional chefs; menu mixes world cuisines with seasonal Turkish produce, with a Bosphorus-view terrace. Open to the public without a museum ticket.
places.address: Emirgan Mah., Sakıp Sabancı Cd. No:42, 34467 Sarıyer/İstanbul (inside Sakıp Sabancı Museum)

places.name: Petra Roasting Co. (Bebek)
places.what_it_is: Garden café on a Bebek back street. A nice coffee stop on a Bosphorus walk.
places.background: Petra describes its Bebek café as an old neighbourhood coffee house in a grandmother's-house-style garden on Bebek's back streets, with the full menu, a General Store corner and the freshest beans.
places.address: Bebek Mah., Küçükbebek Cd. (near No. 38), Beşiktaş/İstanbul

places.name: Petra Roasting Co. (Maslak)
places.what_it_is: In-store Petra coffee bar in a Maslak business district. Not a visitor destination.
places.background: Petra coffee corner inside the MUDO Concept store in Maslak.
places.address: MUDO Concept, Maslak Mah., Eski Büyükdere Cd. No:7, Sarıyer/İstanbul

places.name: Dirty Hands
places.what_it_is: Loud neighbourhood bar with street-food snacks that turns into a mini-club late at night.
places.background: Street-food bar in Akatlar from the team behind Arnavutköy's 'Any' (Time Out, 2016): fried kokoreç bites, bao, tacos, wraps and Tex-Mex burgers with cocktails and tequila shots. After 23:00 the tables are cleared and it turns into a small club.
places.address: Akat, Zeytinoğlu Cd. No:7, 34335 Beşiktaş/İstanbul

places.name: Hide Arnavutköy
tips: An afternoon beer in Arnavutköy.
places.what_it_is: Leafy garden café for brunch or an afternoon drink in Arnavutköy; pricier than neighbours.
places.background: Café-restaurant in a large hidden garden courtyard off Arnavutköy's back streets. Seasonal French/American-leaning menu built around breakfast and lunch, with bakery items, desserts, freshly ground coffee and vegan/gluten-free options (Time Out, 2021).
places.address: Arnavutköy, Dere Sk. No:8, 34345 Beşiktaş/İstanbul

places.name: All Sports Cafe
places.what_it_is: Neighbourhood café-restaurant with sports décor, bowls and desserts; more café than bar.
places.background: Long-running Etiler café decorated with sports memorabilia (a regular in a Nov 2025 review says 25 years). Time Out notes a fixed menu plus a rotating daily menu and a small summer garden; there is also a Nişantaşı branch.
places.address: Etiler, Bıyıklı Mehmet Paşa Sk. No:1 D:2, 34337 Beşiktaş/İstanbul

places.name: Taps Bebek
places.what_it_is: Waterfront brewpub with house beer, burgers and Bosphorus/marina views; relaxed and busy.
places.background: Craft-beer brewpub that started in Nişantaşı in 2002 and has been in Bebek since 2008 (venue website), in a three-storey house on the Bosphorus shore. Brews its own beers (red ale, strong ale, kölsch, rotating drafts) and serves burgers and international pub food.
places.address: Bebek, Cevdetpaşa Cd. No:119, 34342 Beşiktaş/İstanbul

places.name: Sakıp Sabancı Museum (Emirgan)
places.pp: ₺450 adult ticket (₺330 discounted, ₺225 student; free on Tuesdays)
tips: Beautiful museum gardens. The museum has a fixed collection as well as changing exhibitions.
places.what_it_is: Bosphorus-side mansion museum with lovely gardens and big temporary shows.
places.background: Art museum of Sabancı University housed in the 'Atlı Köşk', a former Sabancı family mansion on the Bosphorus in Emirgan. Holds a permanent collection of Ottoman calligraphy and paintings and hosts major temporary international exhibitions; its terraced gardens overlook the Bosphorus.
places.address: Sakıp Sabancı Cd. No:42, Emirgan, 34467 Sarıyer/İstanbul

Photo: Bant ist (talk) · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Balat
places.what_it_is: Colourful old Golden Horn quarter; photogenic streets, cafes, antiques.
places.background: Historic quarter on the Golden Horn in Fatih, traditionally home to Jewish, Greek and Armenian communities. Known for its colourful houses on steep streets, churches and synagogues, and a growing café and antiques scene.

photos.credit: Photo: A.Savin · FAL · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Antoloji · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Mondo79 from Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Antoloji · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Moda
tips: On the Asian side; it has recently stolen the crown from Cihangir as the 'trendiest' place in Istanbul. You can get anything here, including Portuguese custard tarts, Japanese mochi and Vietnamese pho.
Best part: hanging out on the rocks along the waterfront for a sunset beer. Getting there means taking the ferry across the Bosphorus, another key part of Istanbul.
places.what_it_is: Trendy Asian-side quarter; cafes, bars and sunset on the seafront rocks.
places.background: Neighbourhood on a small peninsula in Kadıköy on the Asian side, a short walk from Kadıköy ferry pier. Known for its cafés and bars, Moda Sahili seafront park and rocky shoreline popular at sunset.

places.name: 700 Gram
tips: The tastiest eggs Benedict (Moda).
places.what_it_is: Neighbourhood breakfast/brunch café in Moda; eggs Benedict variants are on the menu (Yandex review summary mentions salmon Benedict).
places.background: Small Moda café reviewed by Time Out Istanbul in 2015: breakfast plates with three cheeses, olives, buffalo cream and homemade jam, filling toasts, and eggs and greens from the owners' garden in Yakacık.
places.address: Caferağa Mah., Ruşen Ağa Sk. No:3/C, Moda, 34710 Kadıköy/İstanbul

places.name: Çiya Sofrası
tips: Turkish food on the Asian side.
places.what_it_is: Canteen-style counter of rotating regional Anatolian dishes; go at lunch for the widest choice.
places.background: Musa Dağdeviren's restaurant in the Kadıköy market. It grew out of a modest kebab shop, and researches and revives regional Anatolian, Mesopotamian and Caucasian recipes. It was featured in Netflix's Chef's Table (vol. 5) and ranked on Opinionated About Dining's Casual Europe list in 2024 and 2025.
places.address: Caferağa, Güneşlibahçe Sk. No:43, 34710 Kadıköy/İstanbul

places.name: Viktor Levi Şarap Evi
tips: A beautiful garden to enjoy a long evening dinner with friends (Moda).
places.what_it_is: Big, lively courtyard garden for long wine-fuelled dinners with friends; the food is secondary.
places.background: Wine house descended from the historic Viktor Levi wine shop founded in Beyoğlu (1914, per aggregator; the Beyoğlu venue has closed per Time Out). It now operates in Moda with a large courtyard garden, house wines such as Papaz Karası and Ada Karası, fruit wines and a bistro menu of grills, pasta and cheese plates.
places.address: Caferağa Mh., Moda Cd., Damacı Sk. No:4, Kadıköy/İstanbul (behind Reks Cinema)

places.name: Story Coffee & Food
places.what_it_is: Roaster café in an old Moda house with garden, good for coffee and brunch (burritos, pancakes).
places.background: Moda flagship of Story Coffee Roasters, who roast their own coffee in Istanbul. It sits in a historic building with a garden. Story also has cafés in Yeldeğirmeni (Halitağa Cad. 61) and Tepe Nautilus mall.
places.address: Caferağa Mah., Dalga Sk. No:22, Moda, Kadıköy/İstanbul

places.name: Montag Coffee (Moda)
places.what_it_is: Local roaster's café on a Moda back street, steps from Story.
places.background: Moda branch of Montag Coffee, a Kadıköy specialty roaster that guides credit with bringing third-wave coffee to Kadıköy in the mid-2010s (2014–2015, sources differ). Montag roasts its own beans and has cafés in Kadıköy (Muvakkithane Cad.), Moda and Bomonti.
places.address: Caferağa Mah. Bademaltı Sok. No:22/A, Moda, Kadıköy/İstanbul
